good.hook: Why does the sea rise twice a day?

captions.text: Why does the sea rise twice a day?
The Moon pulls the ocean toward it.
The far side bulges too, because Earth is pulled away from that water.
Earth turns through both bulges every 24 hours and 50 minutes.
So most coasts get two high tides a day.
